% chart_scale: scalability of VIGOR-DFA. Single column, final width 3.45 in.
% (a) LAN latency with t = 1,2,3 MAC lanes normalized to semi-honest trusted DFA (../data/lanes.csv)
% (b) PIR throughput (queries/s, log y) vs. number of entries 2^14..2^24          (../data/pir_scaling.csv)
% Office look as DFA figure_05; values are the measured results of Section VIII,
% regenerated by the App. F cost model (model/perf_model.py) as a cross-check.
% Build: sh build_chart.sh chart_scale   (from this folder)
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage[scaled=0.92]{helvet}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{textcomp}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\usetikzlibrary{calc,arrows.meta}

% Office palette (DFA figure_05)
\definecolor{cOrange}{HTML}{ED7D31}
\definecolor{cBlue}{HTML}{5B9BD5}
\definecolor{cGrey}{HTML}{A5A5A5}
\definecolor{cGold}{HTML}{FFC000}
\definecolor{cDGold}{HTML}{BF9000}
\definecolor{cDBlue}{HTML}{4472C4}
\definecolor{cGreen}{HTML}{70AD47}
\definecolor{cGrid}{HTML}{D9D9D9}
\definecolor{cAxis}{HTML}{A6A6A6}
\definecolor{cText}{HTML}{262626}
\definecolor{cNote}{HTML}{595959}
\colorlet{estRed}{red}   % red accent used for the paper's call-outs

\newcommand{\lgf}{\fontsize{7.2}{8.2}\selectfont}   % legends, data labels (>= 6.6 pt glyphs)
\newcommand{\tkf}{\footnotesize}                     % ticks, axis labels, panel tags
\newcommand{\pw}[1]{2\textsuperscript{#1}}           % sans-serif power of two
\newcommand{\ts}{\textit{t}}

\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{../data/lanes.csv}\lanesT
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{../data/pir_scaling.csv}\pirT
% normalize to semi-honest trusted DFA (column tdfa)
\pgfplotstablecreatecol[create col/expr={\thisrow{t1}/\thisrow{tdfa}}]{n1}{\lanesT}
\pgfplotstablecreatecol[create col/expr={\thisrow{t2}/\thisrow{tdfa}}]{n2}{\lanesT}
\pgfplotstablecreatecol[create col/expr={\thisrow{t3}/\thisrow{tdfa}}]{n3}{\lanesT}

\pgfplotsset{
  office/.style={
    scale only axis,
    axis x line*=bottom, axis y line*=left,
    y axis line style={draw=none},
    x axis line style={draw=cAxis, line width=0.6pt},
    ymajorgrids, grid style={draw=cGrid, line width=0.45pt},
    major tick length=0pt, tick style={draw=none},
    tick label style={font=\tkf, text=cText},
    label style={font=\tkf, text=cText},
    clip=false,
    xlabel style={yshift=2pt}, ylabel style={yshift=-3pt},
    legend cell align=left,
    legend style={draw=none, fill=none, font=\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south west,
                  inner sep=0pt, row sep=0pt, nodes={inner sep=0.45pt}},
  },
  sqleg/.style={legend image code/.code={\fill[##1] (0cm,-0.09cm) rectangle (0.18cm,0.09cm);}},
  refleg/.style={legend image code/.code={\draw[##1] (-0.06cm,0cm) -- (0.24cm,0cm);}},
  lineleg/.style={legend image code/.code={%
      \draw[##1, mark repeat=2, mark phase=2] plot coordinates {(0cm,0cm) (0.2cm,0cm) (0.4cm,0cm)};}},
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\tkf, text=cText]

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- (a) MAC lanes
\begin{axis}[office, name=A, at={(0,0)}, width=3.40cm, height=2.10cm,
    ybar=0.6pt, bar width=0.19cm, ymin=0, ymax=4, ytick={0,1,...,4},
    enlarge x limits=0.15,
    xtick=data,
    xticklabels from table={\lanesT}{model},
    xticklabel style={rotate=22, anchor=north east, inner sep=1pt, font=\lgf},
    ylabel={Norm.\ latency (\texttimes)},
    yticklabel={\pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\tick}},
    sqleg,
    legend style={at={(-0.215,1.045)}},
  ]
  \addplot[fill=cGrey,   draw=none] table[x expr=\coordindex, y=n1] {\lanesT};
  \addplot[fill=cBlue,   draw=none] table[x expr=\coordindex, y=n2] {\lanesT};
  \addplot[fill=cOrange, draw=none] table[x expr=\coordindex, y=n3] {\lanesT};
  % reference: semi-honest trusted DFA = 1
  \addplot[sharp plot, draw=cText, line width=0.7pt, dash pattern=on 2.2pt off 1.4pt, refleg]
           coordinates {(-0.45,1) (3.45,1)};
  \legend{\ts\,=\,1 \ (\pw{\textminus28}), \ts\,=\,2 \ (\pw{\textminus88}),
          \ts\,=\,3 \ (\pw{\textminus148}), Trusted DFA (SH)}
  % red data labels on the default t = 3 bars (third bar of each group)
  \pgfplotsinvokeforeach{0,1,2,3}{%
    \pgfplotstablegetelem{#1}{n3}\of{\lanesT}\edef\val{\pgfplotsretval}%
    \edef\tmp{\noexpand\node[font=\noexpand\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south, inner sep=1.2pt]
      at ([xshift=0.19cm+0.6pt]axis cs:#1,\val) {\noexpand\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=1, zerofill,
        assume math mode=true]{\val}};}\tmp}
\end{axis}
% note explaining the parenthesized statistical term
\node[font=\lgf, text=cNote, anchor=north west, align=left, inner sep=0pt]
  at ($(A.north west)+(1.95cm,1.13cm)$)
  {In parentheses:\\[-0.4pt] statistical term\\[-0.4pt] \textit{Q}(2/\textit{p})\textsuperscript{\textit{t}}
   at\\[-0.4pt] \textit{Q}\,=\,2\textsuperscript{32}};

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- (b) PIR
% first and last VIGOR-DFA rows (read here so that the values survive the axis group)
\pgfplotstablegetelem{0}{vigor}\of{\pirT}\edef\vfirst{\pgfplotsretval}
\pgfplotstablegetrowsof{\pirT}\pgfmathtruncatemacro{\pirLast}{\pgfplotsretval-1}
\pgfplotstablegetelem{\pirLast}{vigor}\of{\pirT}\edef\vlast{\pgfplotsretval}
\begin{axis}[office, name=B, at={(4.62cm,0)}, width=3.10cm, height=2.10cm,
    ymode=log, log basis y=10, ymin=30, ymax=6e6,
    ytick={1e2,1e3,1e4,1e5,1e6},
    yticklabel={10\textsuperscript{\pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\tick}}},
    xmin=13.6, xmax=24.4, xtick={14,16,...,24},
    xticklabel={\pw{\pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\tick}}},
    xlabel={Entries \textit{N}}, ylabel={Queries/s},
    every axis plot/.append style={line width=1.0pt, mark size=1.3pt},
    lineleg,
    legend style={at={(-0.30,1.045)}},
  ]
  \addplot[cGrey, mark=*] table[x=log2N, y=gpu_dpf] {\pirT};
  \addplot[cBlue, line width=1.7pt, mark=square*, mark size=1.9pt, mark options={fill=white, line width=0.6pt}]
          table[x=log2N, y=dfa_sh] {\pirT};
  \addplot[cOrange, mark=*, mark size=1.1pt] table[x=log2N, y=vigor] {\pirT};
  \addplot[cDGold, mark=diamond*, mark size=1.7pt, mark options={fill=cGold, draw=cDGold, line width=0.4pt}]
          table[x=log2N, y=apir] {\pirT};
  \legend{GPU-DPF (SH), GPU+DFA (SH), GPU+VIGOR-DFA (Mal), GPU-DPF+APIR (Mal)}
  % anchors for the red end-point labels of the VIGOR-DFA curve
  \coordinate (vF) at (axis cs:14,\vfirst);
  \coordinate (vL) at (axis cs:24,\vlast);
  \coordinate (vFt) at (axis cs:14.25,1.55e6);
  \coordinate (vLt) at (axis cs:24,6.2e3);
\end{axis}
\pgfkeys{/pgf/number format/.cd, fixed, 1000 sep={,}}
\node[font=\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south west, inner sep=0.8pt] (lf) at (vFt)
  {\pgfkeys{/pgf/fpu=true, /pgf/fpu/output format=fixed}\pgfmathparse{\vfirst/1e6}\edef\vM{\pgfmathresult}%
   \pgfkeys{/pgf/fpu=false}\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=2, assume math mode=true]{\vM}\,M};
\node[font=\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south east, inner sep=0.8pt] (ll) at (vLt)
  {\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=0, 1000 sep={,}, assume math mode=true]{\vlast}};
\draw[cText, line width=0.4pt] (ll.south east) ++(-0.05cm,0) -- ([yshift=2.4pt]vL);

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- panel tags
\node[anchor=base] at ($(A.south)+(0,-1.10cm)$) {(a)};
\node[anchor=base] at ($(B.south)+(0,-1.10cm)$) {(b)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
